# `projects` — `/api/projects`

Minimal project CRUD (roadmap 4.1) — the connective tissue that lets a conversation, memory, or knowledge source declare which project they belong to. Deliberately does not touch lora_projects/content_projects/music_assets — those already work standalone; unifying them is a separate, larger initiative.

| Method | Path | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/projects`](#get-api-projects) | Every project, most recently updated first. |
| POST | [`/api/projects`](#post-api-projects) | Create a project and return its row. |
| PUT | [`/api/projects/{project_id}`](#put-api-projects-project-id) | Change a project's name and description. |
| DELETE | [`/api/projects/{project_id}`](#delete-api-projects-project-id) | Deletes the project itself only — conversations/memories/knowledge sources linked to it keep their project_id (now pointing at a deleted row) rather than being deleted or silently reassigned; the frontend treats an unresolvable project_id the same as no project. |
| GET | [`/api/projects/{project_id}/summary`](#get-api-projects-project-id-summary) | Counts only — enough for a project switcher to show what's attached to a project without each caller re-implementing the same three counts. |

<a id="get-api-projects"></a>
### `GET /api/projects`

Every project, most recently updated first.

- Handler: [`list_projects`](../../../backend/routers/projects.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Response**

- `200`: JSON list of rows of `projects`: `id`, `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`

<a id="delete-api-projects-project-id"></a>
### `DELETE /api/projects/{project_id}`

Deletes the project itself only — conversations/memories/knowledge sources linked to it keep their project_id (now pointing at a deleted row) rather than being deleted or silently reassigned; the frontend treats an unresolvable project_id the same as no project.

- Handler: [`delete_project`](../../../backend/routers/projects.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `deleted`

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |

<a id="get-api-projects-project-id-summary"></a>
### `GET /api/projects/{project_id}/summary`

Counts only — enough for a project switcher to show what's attached to a project without each caller re-implementing the same three counts.

- Handler: [`project_summary`](../../../backend/routers/projects.py)
- Access: this computer only, or the API key once `ARYNWOOD_API_KEY` is set

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `project_id` | path | integer | yes |  |  |

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `project` (a row of `projects`: `id`, `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`), `conversations` (the `n` value of a row of `projects`: `id`, `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`), `memories` (the `n` value of a row of `projects`: `id`, `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`), `knowledge_sources` (the `n` value of a row of `projects`: `id`, `name`, `description`, `created_at`, `updated_at`)

**Errors** (plus the [access errors](../README.md#errors) every route can return)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Project not found | `project_summary` |
| 422 | The parameters or body don't match the tables above (FastAPI's `detail` list) | FastAPI |
